title: Rote counting to 100
keyIdea: Rote counting is saying number names in order from 0 to 100 — forwards, backwards, or starting from any number — without skipping or repeating.
familyTip: Count aloud in the car to 20, then from 47 to 55. Try backward from 20. Catch skips together: 'Did we say 16?'

visual.caption: Fair counting idea or mix-up? Drag each clue, or tap it and then tap a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: count to 20, on toward 100, back, start at 47, catch slips, challenge.

kid: Rote counting means saying number names in order.
You can count forward to 100, backward from 20, or start in the middle like 47.
Do not skip a number or say the same number twice.
adult: CCSS K.CC.1–2 / NC Y1 NPV: recite 1–100, count on from any number, count back. Words: sequence, forward, backward, skip, repeat.
Common mistakes: skipping (15, 17); repeating; restarting at 1 when asked to begin at 47; confusing rote saying with skip-counting in 2s.
In the lab your child taps a track to 20 and 40, counts back to 10, continues from 47, and spots a skipped-16 slip.

practice.hint: Say the very next number name.
Keep going — do not restart at 1.
Add one to the number you hear.
practice.explain: After {n} the next name in order is {=n+1}. Do not skip.

practice.hint: Count back one name from the number you hear.
practice.explain: Before {n} the prior name in order is {=n-1}.

practice.prompt: Order: count on from a middle start.
practice.hint: Begin where you are told, then continue.
practice.explain: Start anywhere in the sequence and continue in order.

pool.hint: Ones roll into the next ten.
pool.explain: After 29 the ones roll over: the next name is 30.

pool.hint: Backward uses the same order in reverse.
Look for a missing or repeated name.
pool.explain: 15 to 17 skips 16 — that is a slip.

pool.hint: Think of the spoken number list.
pool.explain: Rote counting is the ordered number-name sequence.
After {n} comes {=n+1} when you count forward by ones.
Before {n} comes {=n-1} when you count backward by ones.
After 99 the sequence reaches 100, the end of this count.

items: notice a gap in the list
pool.hint: Catch the skip, fill it, then keep going.
pool.explain: Repair skips, then resume the sequence.
